GET /v1/workspaces.note: Cloud includes account metadata such as `uid`, `status`, and `labels`. OSS Server returns local workspace state. The top deployment filter selects the matching response schema and example. Cloud paginates with `limit` (25, 50, or 100) and `after`; the next cursor is in the `X-Next-Cursor` response header. OSS Server returns all active workspaces.

value.name: limit
value.description: Cloud only: page size. OSS Server ignores this parameter.

value.name: after
value.description: Cloud only: cursor from X-Next-Cursor.

POST /v1/workspaces.note: Cloud includes account metadata such as `uid`, `status`, and `labels`. OSS Server returns local workspace state. The top deployment filter selects the matching response schema and example. Cloud creates with `201` and returns `409` for an existing name. OSS Server can return `200` for an identical retry or policy explanation. `explain=true` is supported only by OSS Server.

value.name: explain
value.description: OSS Server only: preview policy decisions without running the call. Cloud rejects true.

update.value: Create a workspace from a configuration or a saved template. Policies check the configuration before creation and return 403 on refusal.

GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.note: Cloud includes account metadata such as `uid`, `status`, and `labels`. OSS Server returns local workspace state. The top deployment filter selects the matching response schema and example. `verbose` applies only to OSS Server.

DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.note: Cloud retains deleted workspace files for its restore window. OSS Server removes the workspace from the server.

GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/logs.note: JSON logs use Unix epoch **seconds** for `started_at` in Cloud and **milliseconds** in OSS Server. JSONL exports use Unix epoch milliseconds in both deployments. Cursors are opaque and must stay with the same deployment and filters.

update.value: Return completed commands newest first by start time and ID, including mount calls. Durations are milliseconds in both deployments. JSONL exports all retained matching commands oldest first as command, vfs, and result records linked by parent IDs; it ignores limit and after. Empty JSON is `{"items": [], "next": null}`; empty JSONL has an empty body. Retention and cursors are deployment-specific; pagination is not a snapshot.

POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stop.note: Cloud includes account metadata such as `uid`, `status`, and `labels`. OSS Server returns local workspace state. The top deployment filter selects the matching response schema and example. On OSS Server, RAM files do not survive stopping and starting. Save them to persistent storage before stopping.

POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/start.note: Cloud includes account metadata such as `uid`, `status`, and `labels`. OSS Server returns local workspace state. The top deployment filter selects the matching response schema and example. On OSS Server, RAM files do not survive stopping and starting. Save them to persistent storage before stopping.

yet and the newest ended ones, a session's or those in a state when
